description: Figure 2 (left plot of the pair) is a small vertical bar chart illustrating an ablation study result on the INSPIRED dataset by showing NDCG@10 values for different system variants. The horizontal axis contains four categorical labels—“Ours,” “-critiquing,” “-scoring,” and “-ranking”—arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “NDCG@10” with a linear numeric scale marked from 0.00 up to 0.25 in regular 0.05 tick increments. All bars are solid orange with no visible legend, outlines, or annotations; the approximate bar heights are about 0.21 for “Ours,” about 0.19 for “-critiquing,” about 0.09 for “-scoring,” and about 0.13 for “-ranking.” The categories do not appear to be sorted by value, and no bar is visually emphasized beyond the uniform styling.
